blockingIssues.problem: The title asserts that 25 grants have been awarded, but the source states the draft only proposes 25 awards and that no awards have been made.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: Source: "The draft proposes 25 awards; no awards have been made." Also: "applications are not open. If approved in March, applications would open in May."
blockingIssues.constraint: The source only supports stating that 25 awards are proposed and that any awards are conditional on board approval; it does not support saying awards have been made.
